task.title: Manual heating and air conditioning (A/C) operation
task.shortdesc: The heating and cooling system can be controlled manually by pressing buttons other than the AUTO button.

keywords.indexterm: automatic climate control system manual heating and air conditioning (A/C) operation

context.p: To manually operate the heating and A/C, follow these steps:

step.cmd: Set the temperature control as desired.
Set the air intake control to external air.
Set the desired fan speed. Turn the A/C system on if desired.
If desired, turn the air conditioning on with the temperature set high in order to dehumidify the air before it enters into the cabin.

info.p: If the windshield fogs up, select the front defrost mode.

postreq.p: Press the AUTO button to switch to the automatically controlled climate system.
